prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: Impeccable dashboard composition decision comp for Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar. Primary request: create a polished 1600x1000 landscape web application comp that shows two coordinated product surfaces in one presentation: a larger customer dashboard on the left and a smaller admin appointment workspace on the right. Structure: VANITY TRAY WORKSPACE — every task has a precise compartment like salon tools arranged before a treatment; customer side has a refined navigation rail, Welcome back Francis, four compact visit metrics, one dominant Next Appointment tray, recent notifications, and a clear Book appointment action; admin side has Today’s appointments, 5 bookings, customer/service/time rows, Pending/Completed/Cancelled status pills, and compact actions. Input image: the approved Soft Luxury Salon public-site comp is the style reference; carry over only its off-white porcelain ground, deep navy type, plum primary actions, blush accents, restrained brass details, refined serif-plus-clean-sans character, fine lines, and photographic polish; do not copy its landing-page hero, navigation, or content. Style/medium: production-grade accessible desktop SaaS UI, soft luxury salon identity, deliberate asymmetry, shallow tray-like fields with varied hierarchy rather than a generic bento grid. Palette: warm white #F8F5F1, deep ink #17172E, plum #6C147E, blush #E8649A, restrained brass #B69A42. Text to render legibly where possible: Astrid Nails & Beauty Bar; Welcome back, Francis; Next Appointment; Book appointment; Today’s appointments; 5 bookings; Pending; Completed; Cancelled. Constraints: first viewport only, realistic working interface, no invented ratings, awards, revenue, certifications, or customer counts; no gradients, no excessive pill containers, no all-rounded-card grid, no device mockups, no people, no watermarks, no illegible pseudo-text. Keep controls familiar and operations scan-friendly.
